column1: # Store-asset provenance for this directory. Read by the publish gate
# (zero-check.sh --public-tree). See docs/screenshot-capture-playbook.md.
# FORMAT (tab-separated):  filename <TAB> sha256 <TAB> buildType <TAB> commit
# EVERY regular file in this directory needs an entry. A missing entry, a missing file,
# a duplicate entry, or a checksum that does not match all FAIL.
# The COMMIT column is checked too, as of M-99: `zero-check.sh` in PRIVATE mode asserts
# that the recorded commit resolves and that THIS FILE AT THAT COMMIT has the sha256 in
# column 2. It is checked privately, not at publish, because these are private-repo
# commits and the public repo's squashed history does not contain them. Before M-99
# nothing read this column at all, and the value below was a commit at which this file
# DID NOT EXIST — record a commit whose tree actually holds the bytes you are attesting.
# The commit must be a full 40-char lowercase SHA and an ancestor of HEAD.
# ⚠️ THE COMMIT COLUMN REFERS TO THE PRIVATE DEVELOPMENT REPOSITORY, and these SHAs are
# NOT resolvable in this public tree — its history is a squashed seed plus follow-ups.
# The column is verified there, on every pull request, by the private gate; it is not a
# claim a reader of this repo can check, and it is recorded here for traceability, not
# as public evidence. Stated explicitly because an unverifiable field that LOOKS
# checkable is the same decoration this manifest removed the `designed` buildType for.
# buildType:
#   release            captured from a release build            -> pass
#   unverified-legacy  provenance never established             -> pass, named loudly
#   debug              captured from a debug build              -> FAIL
# There is no buildType for artwork with no build behind it. A `designed` value existed
# for that ("evidence required on the entry": byte-identity to a branding/ source, or
# dimensions no device capture produces) and was REMOVED — nothing in the gate ever read
# that evidence, so an entry claiming `designed` with no evidence at all passed exactly
# the same as one with it. Confirmed by planting a real device capture labelled `designed`
# and watching it pass at exit 0. Artwork attests as `unverified-legacy` like anything else
# of unproven origin.
# ⚠️ PERMANENT WARNING — icon.png's provenance is UNVERIFIED by the gate. It is, in fact,
# byte-identical to branding/pilcrow-icon-512.png (same sha256 below), itself derived from
# branding/pilcrow-icon-master.png (1254x1254); 512x512 is the store-icon spec, while a
# device capture from this project is 1080x2340. That fact is true but the gate cannot
# check it mechanically without rebuilding the same hole for the next asset made elsewhere
# — so it is recorded here, in prose, for a human to verify, not encoded as a passing value.
icon.png
